build_aqua_dataset: run the build function to download and set up the AQuA dataset from DeepMind
download_aqua_resources: download the AQuA dataset zip file from the DeepMind GitHub repository
check_aqua_data_built: check if the AQuA dataset has already been built at the current version
remove_outdated_aqua_data: remove an older version of the AQuA dataset directory before rebuilding
mark_aqua_data_done: mark the AQuA dataset directory as built with the current version string
